# OM Astrology AMC

> OM Astrology AMC is a premier Indian Vedic astrology, numerology, tarot reading, and graphology (handwriting & signature analysis) consultancy and educational platform. Founded with 9+ years of master consulting experience, it provides personalized 1-on-1 consultations, certified occult courses, spiritual remedy products, and automated Vedic astrological calculators.

OM Astrology AMC merges ancient Vedic traditions with modern analytical methods, including the proprietary FEAN Method (Formula of Exact Astrological Numbers / Occult Synthesis). It serves clients globally for birth chart analysis, career and marriage guidance, corporate branding numerology, and signature graphotherapy.

Website: https://omastrologyamc.com
Canonical Domain: https://www.omastrologyamc.com

## Core Consultations & Services

- [Vedic Astrology Consultation](https://omastrologyamc.com/astrology): Detailed birth chart (Kundli) analysis covering planetary placements, houses, dasha periods, yogas, and dosha remedies.
- [Numerology & Name Correction](https://omastrologyamc.com/name-correction): Chaldean and Pythagorean name analysis and spelling optimization for career, financial, and personal harmony.
- [Numerology Guidance](https://omastrologyamc.com/numerology): Complete numerological evaluation including Psychic Number (Driver), Destiny Number (Conductor), and Kua number.
- [Tarot Card Guidance](https://omastrologyamc.com/tarot-card): Intuitive Tarot card spreads (Three-Card, Celtic Cross, Major Arcana) for relationship, career, and life decision clarity.
- [Graphology & Handwriting Analysis](https://omastrologyamc.com/graphology): Subconscious personality assessment through strokes, margins, pressure, slant, and graphotherapy exercises.
- [Marriage Matching & Compatibility](https://omastrologyamc.com/marriage-matching): Vedic Ashta-Kuta (36 Gunas) matching, Manglik dosha analysis, and synastry reports for couples.
- [Career & Profession Astrology](https://omastrologyamc.com/profession-career): 10th house karmic analysis, D10 Dashamsha chart breakdown, and planetary career indicators.
- [Lucky Mobile Number Consultation](https://omastrologyamc.com/lucky-mobile): Mobile number vibration optimization using numerology grid and pair harmonies.
- [Corporate & Brand Numerology](https://omastrologyamc.com/corporate-numerology): Business name spelling vibration, logo color selection, partnership compatibility, and incorporation dates.
- [1-on-1 Consultation Appointments](https://omastrologyamc.com/appointments): Direct private video or voice appointments with master astrologers and consultants.
